name: Obfuscation
intro: Target: vault02. The flag is stored, but not in plain text.
objective: Find the stored credentials, decode them, and submit the flag.
hints: Read readme.txt first. It tells you where the backups live.
The odd-looking text in creds.enc is encoded, not encrypted. Try: decode b64 <text>
Double-click the encoded text to select it, press Ctrl+C, type 'decode b64 ' and press Ctrl+V.

srv.readme.txt: Backups live in /srv/backup. Credentials are encoded for safety.
